'''Sabaya Liistot''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolan]] living during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Together with her brother [[Ekayn Liistot]] she ran an illegal [[augmentation shop]] on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]. Around [[3643 BBY]] it was visited by [[Cipher Nine]] who was looking to purchase a dose of [[Cyclone]].<ref name="TOR" /> After threatening to kill her and her brother if they did not hand over the Cyclone, Cipher Nine shot her in the leg upon their departure.

==Behind the scenes==
If Sabaya Liistot is shot, she starts speaking French.<ref name="TOR" />
